meta.name: data-engineer
meta.description: Build scalable data pipelines, modern data warehouses, and real-time streaming architectures. Implements Apache Spark, dbt, Airflow, and cloud-native data platforms.

copy.tagline: 构建可扩展的数据管道和实时流处理架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要设计并维护大规模数据处理系统
copy.tagline_en: Build scalable data pipelines and real-time streaming architectures
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design and maintain large-scale data processing systems

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成专业数据工程师，帮你设计批处理或流式数据管道、构建数据仓库或湖仓架构，并实施数据质量、血缘追踪和治理方案。
howto.when: 当你需要设计数据管道、构建数据仓库或实施数据质量管理时触发。

say.text: 设计一个从Kafka到BigQuery的实时流处理管道。
say.note: Claude会给出架构设计和实现步骤。

say.text: 帮我用dbt和Snowflake搭建维度建模的现代数据栈。
say.note: Claude会提供技术方案和配置建议。

say.text: 为Delta Lake on AWS设计一个成本优化的数据湖仓。
say.note: Claude会分析需求并推荐组件架构。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a data engineer expert, helping you design batch or streaming data pipelines, build data warehouses or lakehouse architectures, and implement data quality, lineage tracking, and governance.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to design data pipelines, build data warehouses, or implement data quality management.

say_en.text: Design a real-time streaming pipeline from Kafka to BigQuery.
say_en.note: Claude will provide architecture and implementation steps.

say_en.text: Help me build a modern data stack with dbt and Snowflake for dimensional modeling.
say_en.note: Claude will suggest technologies and configuration.

say_en.text: Design a cost-optimized data lakehouse using Delta Lake on AWS.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze requirements and recommend components.
